info.title: Dida365 Open API
info.description: Dida365 Open API provides authenticated access to tasks, projects, project groups, kanban columns, tags, comments, focus records, countdowns, and habits. Register an application in the Dida365 Developer Center, use the OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow, and send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Mutation endpoints require `tasks:write`; read-only endpoints require `tasks:read`.
